quote: He traced the knots on the sheet's reefing line with his thumb as he worked—an old helmsman's habit that smoothed his hands and his temper—and hummed a thin lullaby under his breath.
"Ibrahim rode the helm with the same small rituals..."
"They're curious,' he said. 'Like children with a new toy. They don't know what to take, so they pinch at the edges. We'll give them nothing.'"
